---
title: "Time Series Analysis with R"
subtitle: "I5TSA course practicals and assignments"
---

This site is a working notebook for the Time Series Analysis course. Each practical keeps the question, R code, output, and interpretation together so the analysis can be rerun and reviewed.

## Start here

1. Open the [project README](README.md) for installation and publishing instructions.
2. Review [Chapter 1 Practice: Introduction](practice/ch01-introduction.qmd) for textbook concepts, exhibits, and exercises from Cryer & Chan.
3. Work through [TP 01: Introduction](TP01/tp01.qmd) for lab solutions and simulated random processes.
4. Use [TP 02: Mathematical foundations](TP02/tp02.qmd) for stationarity and autocovariance exercises.
5. Start new submissions from the [assignment guide](assignments/index.qmd).

## Working method

For each question, record the **method**, show the **code or derivation**, and write a short **interpretation**. Set a seed before random simulations, label plots, and state the source of each dataset. Keep personal or restricted data out of the public repository.

::: {.callout-note}
## Course materials

The original handouts are kept locally. The pages here provide a structure for your own work; check the handouts and reference book for the full questions.
:::
